name: Seedwake
description: Coaxes sprouts, buds, and young growth into immediate usefulness.

name: Beast Calm
description: Soothes fear or aggression in ordinary animals and makes the caster seem less threatening.

name: Forager's Sense
description: Sharpens perception for water, spoor, edible plants, rot, disease, and nearby ecological disturbance.

name: Thorn Lash
description: Animates briars, roots, or vines into a brief strike or entangling snap.

name: Sap Mend
description: Stabilizes plants, fresh-cut wood, natural fibers, and modest organic injury.

name: Vine Snare
description: Summons roots and creepers to bind ankles, weapons, wheels, or a narrow path.

name: Barkskin
description: Hardens skin or clothing with layered living fiber that reduces cuts, glancing blows, and bleeding.

name: Bloom of Remedy
description: Forces medicinal plants, herbs, and restorative growth to mature rapidly for treatment or triage.

name: Speak to the Small Wild
description: Allows meaningful exchange with beasts, birds, insects, vermin, and local spirits of growth and place.

name: Predator's Aspect
description: Bestows sharpened senses, burst movement, and natural weaponry modeled after a chosen beast.

name: Verdant Surge
description: Drives explosive overgrowth through an area, overtaking roads, walls, trenches, and structures with living terrain.

name: Rot Denied
description: Purges blight, mold, parasites, and unnatural decay from creatures, crops, and sanctified ecosystems.

name: Heartwood Sanctuary
description: Raises a living shelter of trunks, roots, leaves, and medicinal growth that protects, conceals, and nourishes those within.

name: Awaken the Grove
description: Elevates a woodland, marsh, fungal bed, or other living site into active alliance, making the land itself perceive and respond.

name: Sovereign of the Living Land
description: The supreme druidry working: the caster speaks with the authority of ecosystem itself, commanding beasts, growth, and terrain in unified concert.
